stories.title: Minister insists referendum on new provinces 'will happen'
stories.brief: Parliamentary Affairs Minister Tariq Fazal Chaudhry on Friday insisted that a referendum on the formation of new provinces “will happen”. Bilawal had expressed his opposition to the creation of provinces and the idea of holding a referendum for such a move in his speech.

stories.title: Bilawal wants political system to prevail
stories.brief: Addressing the Sindh Wheat Growers Support Programme 2026 in Karachi, Bilawal said Pakistan was facing an unprecedented economic crisis and that the difficulties confronting ordinary citizens should take precedence over political differences.

stories.title: Bilawal wants PM Shehbaz to become first premier to complete 5-year term
stories.brief: PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari said on Friday that he wanted Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif to become the first premier to complete a five-year term in office. I will not do that […] I am saying that I want Shehbaz Sharif to be the first prime minister […] to complete a five-year term,” Bilawal said.

stories.title: French police officers guilty of Michel Zecler assault: What happens now?
stories.brief: Officers dealt more than 30 blows to the Black music producer in what the court ruled was a racially motivated crime.

stories.title: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock
stories.brief: Countries from nearly 200 countries are in a deadlock to try and get a new global climate agreement.

stories.title: At least four killed, 35 injured in fire at power station in Iraq’s Basra
stories.brief: The blaze erupted at the Hartha power station and spread to nearby houses.

stories.title: Three French police officers sentenced over racist assault on Black man
stories.brief: Paris criminal court finds racism was an aggravating factor in the 2020 assault of Black music producer Michel Zecler.

stories.title: Tech stock sell-off drags markets down as Anthropic shares slide
stories.brief: Pressures weighed on US markets, with the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average pushed into correction territory.

stories.title: French police officers sentenced for beating of music producer Michel Zecler
stories.brief: The court has upheld the 2020 beating of the black music producer as an aggravated circumstance of racism.

stories.title: Nasdaq erases all 2026 gains as AI sell-off dampens Anthropic’s second day of trading
stories.brief: On Friday, the Nasdaq Composite erased all its gains for 2026 and closed down 5% from its value on 1 January.

stories.title: Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas
stories.brief: The US president provided little detail on the potential policy, saying others in his team were hearing about it for the first time.

stories.title: Should AI be judging our credit worthiness?
stories.brief: Would AI be a good judge of whether you should get a mortgage, car loan or mobile phone contract?

stories.title: Mysterious Mercury is about to get a visitor - after spacecraft's eight-year epic voyage
stories.brief: The mission is set to give us our best ever view of Mercury - the closest planet to the Sun.

stories.title: More climate money for Africa? Europe says use what's already pledged
stories.brief: African countries at the UN climate summit in Turkey are demanding more funding from developed nations to help them cope with climate change.

stories.title: Cummins wins Cricket Australia's 'unanimous support' to remain Test captain
stories.brief: Cricket Australia threw its “unanimous support” behind Pat Cummins to remain Test captain Saturday, rejecting any suggestion his integrity had been compromised by the lingering “Sandpapergate” scandal. Only then-captain Steve Smith, his deputy David Warner and Bancroft – who used the sandpaper – were found to be responsible by a Cricket Australia probe.

stories.title: Pakistan, Indonesia conclude third edition of bilateral counter-terrorism exercise Elang Strike-III
stories.brief: The Pakistan Army and Indonesian Army concluded the third edition of the bilateral counter-terrorism exercise, Elang Strike-III, at the National Counter Terrorism Centre (NCTC) in Pabbi, the military’s media wing said on Saturday.

stories.title: Iraq fire at Basra power station kills at least four, injures 30
stories.brief: At least 4 people were killed and 30 injured in a fire at a power station in southern Iraq on Saturday, with the toll expected to rise, security officials said.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz condemns Houthi attack on Riyadh’s King Abdullah Financial District
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Saturday strongly condemned the Houthi attack on the King Abdullah Financial District in Riyadh, describing it as an act of “reckless aggression” targeting civilian infrastructure and economic facilities.

stories.title: PM ties offshore exploration to energy security
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Friday linked exploration of potential oil and gas reserves in Pakistan's maritime boundaries to the country's energy security and economic development. He also welcomed Turkey's Minister of Energy and Natural Resources, Alparslan Bayraktar, and thanked the Turkish government and people for standing alongside Pakistan.

stories.title: FCC rejects JUI-F's reserved seat claim
stories.brief: The order noted that the observations by the Election Commission of Pakistan (ECP), the IHC or the FCC on nomination, membership or alleged impersonation shall not conclusively determine those issues in competent election proceedings. The controversy arose after JUI-F submitted its priority list for women's reserved seats for the 2024 general elections.
